source_direct_findings: Statement/v1 binds a predicate type to digest-identified immutable subject artifacts.
Link/v0.3 separates products/subjects from input materials and preserves step identity plus optional command/environment/byproducts.
Runtime Trace/v0.1 structurally separates monitor identity/configuration from monitored-process identity and trace content.
Runtime Trace explicitly warns that monitoring technique changes the strength of evidence guarantees.
Bundle membership is not authenticated as a whole; deletion, replay and injection remain possible without separate freshness/completeness policy.

f2_mapping.in_toto_subject: F2 already has stronger narrow digest binding for BroadcastEnvelope/selection/GRID10 plan and, for positive uptake, downstream_ref + downstream_sha256.
f2_mapping.in_toto_materials: F2 provenance_refs approximate lineage references but are opaque strings rather than typed digest-bearing material descriptors.
f2_mapping.in_toto_predicate_type: F2 schema/classification constants already type the receipt semantics and preserve UNKNOWN/noncausal boundaries.
f2_mapping.in_toto_monitor_identity: MISSING STRUCTURAL EQUIVALENT in CellUptakeReceipt: the observation mechanism/producer that asserts DELIVERED or UPTAKEN is not a typed, digest-bound field.
f2_mapping.in_toto_monitor_config: MISSING STRUCTURAL EQUIVALENT: no observation-method/config digest is part of CellUptakeReceipt.as_dict()/sha256().
f2_mapping.in_toto_bundle_warning: Supports existing F2 law that collection/repetition cannot mint completeness/freshness/causal credit; no bundle import is warranted.

newly_rejected_ambiguity.statement: Two materially different observation mechanisms can assert the same receipt_id/broadcast/cell/delivery/uptake/downstream/provenance_refs and therefore produce the same serialized CellUptakeReceipt/sha256, even when their measurement guarantees differ, because observer identity and observer configuration/method are outside the receipt schema.
newly_rejected_ambiguity.why_material: A synchronous instrumented hook and an asynchronous log-derived observer can have different loss/reordering/completeness guarantees. Current WP507 factory sealing proves construction through the local factory, not which external/host observation mechanism justified the supplied status values.

wp105_comparison.finding: No equivalent new gap is established for WP105 at this E2 scope. Its accepted G4 boundary structurally requires EffectCallBinding and explicit authorizer/executor routing, rejects forged nominal UNKNOWN outcomes, and preserves UNKNOWN post-dispatch. in-toto still offers useful descriptive vocabulary but does not currently justify reopening WP105.

recommended_thin_distillation.target: future WP507 review/falsifier, not direct mutation in Trigger 6
recommended_thin_distillation.design_preference: Prefer one typed ObserverBinding object whose canonical digest is embedded in CellUptakeReceipt rather than six ad-hoc strings.
recommended_thin_distillation.authority_fence: ObserverBinding describes evidence production only. It does not mint world truth, semantic uptake, causal influence, completion, UnifiedDB state or effect authority.

counterhypotheses.statement: Existing provenance_refs can already encode observer identity/configuration by convention, so adding a typed binding is redundant.
counterhypotheses.assessment: Not sufficient at current source scope because the schema validates only nonempty unique strings; it does not require observer semantics, digest binding or a method-strength class.

counterhypotheses.statement: The private factory seal already proves the observer.
counterhypotheses.assessment: Rejected at architecture-map scope: the seal proves the dataclass was created through CellUptakeReceipt.observe in-process. The caller still supplies delivery_status/uptake_status/provenance_refs; the seal does not identify the evidence-producing sensor/hook/log path.

counterhypotheses.statement: Because WP507 grants zero runtime/GWT credit, observer identity is unnecessary.
counterhypotheses.assessment: Rejected for future promotion readiness: repository-component scope is correctly bounded today, but any later target-runtime causal promotion needs exact measurement provenance. The gap should be falsified before such promotion, not silently discovered after it.

next_gate.objective: Construct a deterministic source-level collision fixture showing two distinct ObserverBinding candidates collapse to the same current CellUptakeReceipt digest, then show that a hypothetical canonical observer-binding digest would distinguish them without changing the underlying uptake claim.
next_gate.acceptance: E3 passes only if the collision is reproducible against exact current WP507 source and the distinction is attributable solely to missing observer identity/config binding.
next_gate.falsifier: If exact current WP507 already binds observer identity/configuration into the receipt digest through another mandatory structure, retire this delta as redundant.
